headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue increases and tighter guidance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and an upgraded EBIT margin outlook. HCLTech and TCS delivered solid top‑line growth supported by AI revenue, but Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% revenue growth. Wipro’s revenue rose 9.1% YoY but profit slipped, reflecting margin pressure.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and Wipro introduced a flat‑to‑slight‑decline outlook for Q3.

themes.title: Margin improvements
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin target to 16% and HCLTech maintained an operating margin above 18% in constant currency.
